text: Senior officials with the Toronto Office of Recovery and Rebuild will provide an update on plans for Toronto's post-COVID-19 recovery efforts. The Toronto Office of Recovery and Rebuild will engage members of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee in a consultation on cultural sector considerations for recovery planning.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Chief Recovery and Rebuild Officer, in consultation with appropriate City staff, to incorporate the Committee's suggestions for Recovery and Rebuild into the Toronto Office of Recovery and Rebuild report.
